source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Simple and Compound Propositions (PDF 27, printed 23).

blocks.text: Simple (saada) proposition mein sirf ek statement hota hai. Isay chhote hisson mein nahi tora ja sakta. Maslan “Barish ho rahi hai” simple proposition hai. Compound (murakkab, yani jura hua) proposition do ya zyada simple propositions ko jor kar banta hai. Inhein jorne ke liye logical connectives (jorne wale lafz) istemal hote hain. Maslan “Barish ho rahi hai aur sardi hai” compound proposition hai. Compound propositions mushkil khayalat bayan kar sakte hain aur logical reasoning mein aam hain. Propositional logic mein dono qismein aham hain.

items: Simple: sirf ek statement (“Barish ho rahi hai”).
Compound: connectives se jure do ya zyada statements (“Barish ho rahi hai aur sardi hai”).
